english.note: Use this when someone hurries to a place by crawling or clambering with their limbs, rather than simply walking quickly.

examples.english: The cat had to scramble up to the windowsill when it saw the dog.
examples.traditional: 隻貓見到狗，就急急腳咁爬上窗台。
